verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair axis for a SaaS marketing platform, so the story applies. The evidence pack shows only read endpoints (GET /marketing/v3/emails, post-send statistics) and an MCP server. Nothing documents minting scoped or read-only tokens, permission scopes, or a way to separate analytics read access from send capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can mint scoped or read-only API credentials so an agent or contractor can read analytics without the power to send
